topStories.headline: Lions Enter Playoffs Tonight Against Belton in 5A-DII Bi-District Clash
topStories.dek: Ennis High School's football team travels to Belton's Tiger Field for a first-round UIL playoff game Friday night, prompting an early school dismissal district-wide.
topStories.body:
The Ennis Lions (5-5) punch into the UIL Class 5A Division II bi-district round tonight, Friday, November 13, when they face the Belton Tigers (7-3) at Tiger Field in Belton. Kickoff is set for 7:00 p.m.

Ennis ISD announced this week that all district campuses will release students two hours early on Friday to give families extra time to make the trip to Belton and support the team. The early-release notice, posted on the district website and campus pages, cited the playoff scheduling directly.

The Lions head into the matchup averaging 30.3 points per game this season and are coming off a commanding 56-28 victory over Everman last week — the team's highest-scoring game of the year. Belton, by contrast, is licking wounds after being shut down 35-7 by Brenham in its regular-season finale, its lowest-scoring performance of 2026.

The winner advances to face either South Oak Cliff or Whitehouse in the area round. For Ennis, it is a chance to extend a season that has been a streaky one — 5-2 in district, 5-5 overall — into the deeper bracket.

topStories.headline: City Commission Holds Special Session Today; EDC Meets Tuesday
topStories.dek: Ennis city officials convene two separate public meetings this week — a special commission session this afternoon and an Economic Development Corporation session next Tuesday evening.
topStories.body:
The Ennis City Commission is holding a special meeting this afternoon, Friday, November 13, beginning at 4:00 p.m. The agenda packet — posted on the city's website — runs to nearly 500 kilobytes, suggesting substantive business, though the specific action items are contained in the attached PDF rather than the event listing. The meeting is open to the public and can be viewed via the city's livestream at ennistx.gov.

Five days later, on Tuesday, November 18 at 5:00 p.m., the Ennis Economic Development Corporation holds its own meeting at Ennis City Hall, 107 N. Sherman Street. An amended agenda was posted this week, indicating the meeting scope was revised after the original notice went out. EDC meetings are open to the public and are typically held on the second Tuesday of each month.

Residents with business before either body can contact City Secretary Bethany Prewitt at 972-875-1234 ext. 2236 or review materials posted at ennistx.gov.

topStories.headline: Keith Boles Settles In as Ennis ISD Interim Superintendent
topStories.dek: Keith Boles began leading Ennis ISD on November 11, days after the board announced his appointment, while newly hired Deputy Superintendent Trent Dowd also comes on board.
topStories.body:
Keith Boles officially took the helm of Ennis Independent School District as interim superintendent on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. The Ennis ISD Board of Trustees announced the appointment in late October; this week marks his first full stretch in the seat.

Boles joins a district that is simultaneously welcoming Trent Dowd as its new Deputy Superintendent. Dowd, who brings more than 20 years of experience in education, was introduced to the community in recent weeks and his hiring was separately celebrated on the district's website.

The dual leadership transition follows the departure of the previous superintendent and comes as the district heads into the Thanksgiving stretch of the school year. Ennis ISD's Thanksgiving break runs from Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27. An early-release day is also on the calendar for December 18, with winter break beginning December 21.

moreNews.headline: Ellis County Posts Current Road Closure List as of November 12
moreNews.body: Ellis County updated its road closure list on November 12, 2026, posting the most current active closures on the county website at elliscountytx.gov. Residents in Ennis, Ferris, Palmer, Italy, and surrounding unincorporated areas are advised to check the list before traveling county roads. The county also confirmed that all Ellis County offices will be closed Thursday and Friday, November 26–27, for Thanksgiving.
